name: Gilt Bronze Pagoda
description: The gilt-bronze pagoda is based on the Stupa, an Indian Buddhist building introduced to my country in the first century AD. The ancients called the Buddhists the pagoda and the Buddhism the pagoda, and later called the pagoda the pagoda. Pinku uses a new metal etching process to create a unique retro texture, showing the mysterious style of ancient architecture. It is made of metal and transcends the beauty of metal.
